localModels.title: Local models
localModels.description: Essential models and required resources are managed automatically. Download optional models here; view or cancel preparation in Task Center.

capabilities.speechAlignment: Align transcript text precisely to audio

modelDescriptions.whisperTiny: Small download and fast inference for limited hardware; lower accuracy on difficult recordings.
modelDescriptions.whisperSmall: Default choice balancing size, speed and accuracy.
modelDescriptions.whisperLargeV3: Higher accuracy, about 3 GB download; requires more memory and is slower on CPU.
modelDescriptions.qwen3Embedding: Required for local knowledge retrieval; uses fixed 1,024-dimensional vectors.
modelDescriptions.mossNano: Compact Chinese and English preset voices and reference cloning. Runs on CPU at normal speed with 48 kHz output.
modelDescriptions.voxCpm2: Voice cloning and design. About 5 GB; requires at least 32 GiB memory. Uses a supported GPU when capacity allows, otherwise CPU.
modelDescriptions.voxCpm2Q8: Q8 voice cloning and design. About 3 GB; requires at least 32 GiB memory. Uses a supported GPU when capacity allows, otherwise CPU.
modelDescriptions.qwen3Aligner: Full model for precise transcript timing. Up to five minutes per selected range.
modelDescriptions.qwen3AlignerQ8: Smaller Q8 model for precise transcript timing. Up to five minutes per selected range.
modelDescriptions.sherpaDiarization: Compact speaker identification, about 41 MB. Automatic or exact speaker count; no account required.
modelDescriptions.spleeter2Stems: FP16 vocals/accompaniment separation on CPU. Up to ten minutes per source; audition both tracks before accepting them.
modelDescriptions.u2netp: Compact CPU background removal, about 5 MB. Results depend on the source image.
modelDescriptions.u2net: Full CPU background-removal model, about 176 MB. Uses more memory and processing time than Compact.
modelDescriptions.sherpaDiarizationFull: Full-precision speaker identification, about 46 MB. Automatic or exact speaker count; no account required.
modelDescriptions.spleeter2StemsFull: FP32 vocals/accompaniment separation on CPU. About twice the compact model’s download size; up to ten minutes per source.

localModels.selectedVoiceModel: Default for new reference voices; saved voices keep their model.
localModels.noResults: No models match your search or filter.
